name: DeerFlow
description: ByteDance's open agent harness that coordinates sub-agents, memory, sandboxes and skills for research, coding and content tasks.
whatItDoes: DeerFlow 2.0 takes on long tasks such as deep research, report and slide generation or building small apps by planning, delegating to sub-agents and running code in a sandbox.
howItWorks: A lead agent built on LangGraph spawns sub-agents, loads skills on demand and executes commands and file operations in a local or Docker sandbox, with long-term memory and MCP servers. A gateway and web frontend are started with make targets after a setup wizard writes the config.

requirements.name: LLM API key
requirements.description: Chosen in the setup wizard and stored in .env

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Recommended way to run, and used for the sandbox

models: OpenAI-compatible providers, Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and others
